1.evidence_source: A total of 509 men from the community in London, UK, completed measures of drive for muscularity, body appreciation, the Big Five domains, and subjective social status, and provided their demographic details.
1._section_summary: This abstract reports a single study of 509 community men in London, United Kingdom, examining links between the Big Five personality traits and body image (drive for muscularity and body appreciation). Regression analyses (controlling for BMI and subjective social status) found Neuroticism positively predicted drive for muscularity and negatively predicted body appreciation, while Extraversion positively predicted body appreciation.
